info.description:
Browse and use the Apwide Environment REST API.
                  API Authorization is a **token** prefixed by **Bearer** set as **Authorization** header.
info.title: Apwide Environment API

get.summary: Get available environment options for a customfield in a project
get.description:
Combine any pre-defined search parameters listed below and pass them to url as query parameters.

Other parameters you can use:
* parameters with no value to perform a free text search on all information of your environments (ex: ?Staging&eCommerce&RedHat)
* name of an attribute as query parameter (ex: ?OS=RedHat&database=Postgresql)

Note that you can send the same parameter multiple times with different values (ex: ?applicationName=eCommerce&applicationName=PaymentService). It will return environments matching at least one of the values
